# Legacy Investing Show

> Expert guidance on tax optimization, wealth building, and Airbnb arbitrage from Preston Seo, who built a $20M+ real estate portfolio and trained 2,000+ students generating $10M+ collective annual revenue.

## Core Expertise Areas (Priority Order)

1. **Tax Strategy & Planning** - Legal strategies to minimize tax liability
2. **Investment Advice & Portfolio Management** - Building diversified wealth
3. **Business Structure & Asset Protection** - LLCs, trusts, and legal entities
4. **Retirement Account Optimization** - Self-directed IRAs and 401(k) strategies
5. **Debt Management Strategies** - Leverage and debt payoff approaches
6. **Airbnb Arbitrage** - Cash flow generation without property ownership
